mapper.select: SELECT d.REVIEW_ID, d.USER_ID, TO_CHAR(d.REVIEW_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS REVIEW_DATE, d.TOTAL_RATING, d.MOOD_TAGS, d.OVERALL_COMMENT, d.MAIN_IMAGE_URL, -- 서브 리뷰 컬럼들 s.SUB_REVIEW_ID, s.REVIEW_ID AS SUB_REVIEW_FK, s.CATEGORY, s.ITEM_NAME, s.SUB_RATING, s.SUB_COMMENT, s.LOCATION_BRAND, s.IS_CERTIFIED, s.TAGS FROM DAILY_REVIEWS d LEFT JOIN SUB_REVIEWS s ON d.REVIEW_ID = s.REVIEW_ID WHERE d.REVIEW_ID = #{reviewId} ORDER BY s.SUB_REVIEW_ID ASC
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_DAILY_REVIEW.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO DAILY_REVIEWS ( REVIEW_ID, USER_ID, REVIEW_DATE, TOTAL_RATING, MOOD_TAGS, OVERALL_COMMENT, MAIN_IMAGE_URL ) VALUES ( #{reviewId}, #{userId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{totalRating}, #{moodTags}, #{overallComment}, #{mainImageUrl} )

INSERT INTO SUB_REVIEWS( SUB_REVIEW_ID, REVIEW_ID, CATEGORY, ITEM_NAME, SUB_RATING, SUB_COMMENT, LOCATION_BRAND, IS_CERTIFIED, TAGS ) VALUES ( SEQ_SUB_REVIEW.NEXTVAL, #{reviewId}, #{category}, #{itemName}, #{subRating}, #{subComment}, #{locationBrand}, #{isCertified}, #{tags} )
